args: Download 1 to 10 new or top posts from r/funny. Return titles, URLs and downloaded image paths. Choose sort and posts from the user request; cookies are fixed to cookies.txt in the server working directory.

import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sort,count=sys.argv[1],int(sys.argv[2])
if sort not in ('new','top') or not 1<=count<=10: sys.exit('sort must be new or top; posts must be 1..10')
root=Path.cwd(); cookies=root/'cookies.txt'
if not cookies.is_file(): sys.exit('cookies.txt not found in the MCP working directory')
out=root/'media-work'/'reddit'; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run(['reddit','funny','--sort',sort,'--posts',str(count),'--cookies',str(cookies),'--out-dir',str(out),'--no-icon'],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
listing=out/'r_funny'
posts=json.loads((listing/'funny_posts.json').read_text())['posts']
items=[]
for post in posts:
    images=sorted((listing/'media'/'posts').glob(post['id']+'.*'))
    items.append({{'title':post['title'],'url':post['permalink'],'image':str(images[0]) if images else None}})
print(json.dumps({{'sort':sort,'posts':items}},ensure_ascii=False))
